newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong financial markets to re-open on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong financial markets to re-open on Thursday.

text.p: Hong Kong financial markets will re-open on Thursday following an extended holiday to celebrate the handover of Hong Kong from Britain to China.
Hong Kong's markets were closed on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday because of the handover, which occurred at midnight (1600 GMT) on June 30.
Hong Kong stocks also were closed for trading in London on Tuesday following the market and public holidays in Hong Kong.
